notes.title: Shell Corp Update 1.0.5
notes.content:
Hi everyone, a quick list of things weve updated today:

[list]
[*]Improved the camera in all game modes
[*]Fixed a bug playing solo and tying showed the wrong text
[*]Implementation of some DLC stuff for PAX X EGX online
[/list]

Don't forget, we'll be at PAX X EGX Online for the entirety of the show and will be having a whole bunch of live streams during! We'll see you there!

tags.bug: Fixed a bug playing solo and tying showed the wrong text

tags.feature: Implementation of some DLC stuff for PAX X EGX online

notes.content:
[list]
[*] Dying in a coffee patch should no longer respawn you all slippery
[*] AI who were added automatically to balance the teams now feature in the team results screen
[*] A bug which sometimes caused countdown text to be too large was fixed
[*] The painting was made easier by having a paintbrush be automatically selected when you select a colour and currently have the eraser selected
[/list]
